title: Screen-free Children: Reclaiming Childhood in the Artificial Intelligence Era
what_it_is: Screen-free Children: Reclaiming Childhood in the Artificial Intelligence Era

sections.label: Childhood as free stage
sections.summary: Childhood below 18 is described as a stage where children should be free to play, wonder and make mistakes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Childhood, below the age of 18, is the one stage of life where children should be free.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Free to play, free to wonder, free to make mistakes, and free from unnecessary pressures and anxieties.

sections.label: Excessive screen use harms
sections.summary: Research in Singapore and globally links excessive screen use to poorer physical activity, social interaction, behaviour and mental wellness.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Research globally and in Singapore similarly links excessive screen use with poorer physical activity, weaker social interaction, behavioural challenges and poorer mental wellness.

sections.label: Four childhood recommendations
sections.summary: Four recommendations are given: community programmes, playgrounds and Play Values Framework, screen-time guidance and safeguards, and whole-of-Government coordination.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Together, they give our children the opportunity to reclaim childhood.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: I have four recommendations: first, strengthen community programmes as meaningful alternatives to screens; second, improve our playgrounds and apply the Play Values Framework more broadly, recognising playgrounds as developmental infrastructure; third, strengthen screen-time guidance, engagement and social media safeguards for children below 18; and fourth, strengthen whole-of-Government coordination on childhood development.

sections.label: LumiPals programme for children
sections.summary: LumiPals is a 10-week programme developing social and creative skills among children aged four to six.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: The second programme is LumiPals, a 10-week programme developing social and creative skills among children aged four to six.

sections.label: Reasons for introducing programmes
sections.summary: Parents reportedly lack time, confidence or support to organise activities, and private outdoor programmes can cost $250 to $800 per child.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: We introduced these programmes because many parents have told us that while resources and ideas exist online, they often lack the time, confidence or support to organise such activities themselves.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Such programmes also already exist privately, some would say, but outdoor programmes can cost anywhere between $250 and $800 per child.

sections.label: HDB playgrounds and Play Values
sections.summary: About 72% of Singapore's playgrounds are in HDB estates, and HDB's Play Values Framework recognises play's developmental importance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: With around 72% of Singapore's playgrounds located within Housing and Development Board (HDB) estates, I welcome HDB's Play Values Framework, which recognises the developmental importance of play.

sections.label: Teen social media use and safeguards
sections.summary: An MOH expert panel found one in three social media users aged 15 to 17 spend over three hours daily, and legislation on teen safeguards is announced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: An MOH-convened expert panel also found that one in three social media users aged 15 to 17 already spend more than three hours a day on social media.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: What else could those hours have been spent doing?

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: I welcome Minister Josephine Teo's announcement last month that legislation will be introduced early next year to require stronger safeguards for teen users, potentially including daily time limits, restrictions on direct messaging, autoplay and infinite scroll.

sections.label: Meta settlement with US states
sections.summary: In August, Meta reached a settlement of up to US$17 billion with US states over its platforms' impact on young users.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: In August, Meta reached a landmark settlement of up to US$17 billion with US states over allegations concerning the impact of its platforms on young users.

sections.label: Childhood and long-term government thinking
sections.summary: The passage states that if human capital remains Singapore's greatest competitive advantage, childhood deserves the same long-term, cross-Government thinking.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: If human capital remains Singapore's greatest competitive advantage, then childhood deserves the same quality of long-term, cross-Government thinking.

sections.label: Reducing screen dependency and coordination
sections.summary: The speaker argues reducing screen dependency requires alternatives, with regulation reducing harm and community programmes, play-friendly neighbourhoods and family support creating healthier choices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Today, I have argued that reducing screen dependency requires meaningful alternatives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Regulation reduces harm, while community programmes, play-friendly neighbourhoods and family support create healthier choices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Our children will grow up as digital natives and screens will remain important tools, but they should never become their companions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Shi Xuan (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Reclaiming childhood will require heavy coordination across Government because no single Ministry can do it alone.

sections.label: PA and Screen Smart programmes
sections.summary: PA has rolled out Family PLAYGround programmes, and the Screen Smart from the Start campaign has a portal with resources, digital parenting programmes and community activities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information, and Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: PA has rolled out the PA Family PLAYGround  programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information, and Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: And so, this is something we can definitely scale and look into.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information, and Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: We also have the "Screen Smart from the Start" campaign and in this, we have the bescreensmart.gov.sg portal, where we actually have resources for parents, there are digital parenting programmes, and also a lot of activities in the community that you can look out for – in the libraries, HPB programmes.

sections.label: Screen time guidelines and social media regulations
sections.summary: Mr Ng suggested strengthening screen time guidelines and social media regulations, and MOH and MDDI are working together on social media's impact on young people's mental health.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information, and Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: Third, Mr Ng suggested we strengthen screen time guidelines as well as our social media regulations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information, and Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: He is already aware that MOH and MDDI are already working together in looking at the impact of social media on the mental health of young people.

sections.label: Grow Well SG holistic approach
sections.summary: Grow Well SG is looked at as a holistic approach.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information, and Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: Actually, Grow Well SG is something that we look at as a holistic approach.

sections.label: Government commitment to children
sections.summary: The Government will continue to be committed to helping children grow healthy, confident and resilient in a digital and AI-driven world.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information, and Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: I just want to assure Member that this is an effort that the Government will continue to be committed to look at.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information, and Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: We are committed to helping children grow to be healthy, confident and resilient, especially in this digital and increasingly AI-driven world.
